object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In the Document Editor, open the grid editor on empty enumeration cells and on a cell holding an option, and leave each without a change; do the same on a cell holding a value that isn't among the attribute's options; do the same with an integer and a date editor on empty cells; give a description and an attribute cell the value it already holds. Then change the integer value and leave the cell. Expected: no edit is made and the object file's bytes stay the same, until the integer value is changed, which is written.
